(4) ULTRA VIRES/EXCESS JURISDICTION EXCEPTION: Where an agency acts in excess of its jurisdiction (as Macomber found CDCR did vis-à-vis §3008), exhaustion of administrative remedies is excused (Hittle v. The 'Eagan' misidentification error is itself excess-of-jurisdiction conduct — an instrument adjudicating a third party by name is void on its face. (5) HABEAS CORPUS (MATTER 19) IS ACTIVE: Hon.
